title: SR-1.29 A hook starts without loading the whole CLI
request: Closes G94: the MEM-098 latency test (test/hooks-latency.test.mjs:64: the prompt hook returns in under 1.5 s while each backend call takes 1 s) fails on the CI runner at 1589 to 1729 ms on 32 of 37 open pull requests, after passing on 28 to 30 October. The hook runs through bin/memev.mjs, which loads the whole CLI (src/cli/main.mjs) for every hook, and src/cli/hooks.mjs loads the engine at start through isVault (src/engine/vault.mjs) and the transcript scanner. Measured on 31 October 2026 on a development machine: node starts in 40 ms, importing main.mjs takes 110 ms and hooks.mjs 140 ms, and the test passes there at 1322 ms. Every hook event calls isVault, which lives in the engine module (src/engine/vault.mjs:39). The fix is to the hook's own start-up, never to the budget. Repository: memev. Depends on contracts: QL-1.02.

tasks.title: The hook path starts light
requirements: bin/memev.mjs hands a hook command (memev hook <event>) to src/cli/hooks.mjs before it imports src/cli/main.mjs; every other command path is unchanged

src/cli/hooks.mjs imports at module load only what every hook event needs; the engine (src/engine/vault.mjs and what it imports), the transcript scanner and any code one event alone uses are imported inside that event's path

isVault and STATE move to a new module, src/engine/vault-marker.mjs, that imports only node built-ins, and src/engine/vault.mjs re-exports both, so there is one definition of 'is a vault' and a hook checks it without loading the engine
the hooks' behaviour, output and exit codes are unchanged, and the 1.5 s budget of MEM-098, MEMEV_HOOK_BUDGET_MS and test/hooks-latency.test.mjs stay as they are
the start-up cost is measured, not assumed: the test records which modules a hook process loads and how long a prompt hook takes with a stub that answers at once

criteria.statement: Spawned as node bin/memev.mjs hook <event> --client claude-code against a stub daemon, with a module-load log (a resolve hook registered through --import from test/helpers/load-log.mjs): the prompt event loads none of src/cli/main.mjs, src/engine/vault.mjs and src/cli/transcript.mjs, and no hook event loads src/cli/main.mjs.
